SECURITY FINDING (daily audit 2026-10-13): packages/functions/src/helpers/redisCache.js cacheSet does `logger.info('[redisCache]', 'set cache', key, value, ttl)` — it logs the whole cached value. Callers cache full shop docs (proxyshop:<domain>, shopdomain:<domain>) which carry Shopify access-token material, plus settings and API responses, so they land in prod logs, which are forwarded to Slack/Firestore errorAlerts.
FIX: cacheSet must never log the value. Log at most key and ttl (or drop the info log entirely if it is pure noise — the set runs on ~22 req/s hot paths). Check every other logger call in helpers/redisCache.js (cacheGet, mget/mset helpers, the ctx.body cache middleware around line 567, logCacheFailure) and remove any that print cached values or payloads; keys are fine.
Test: helpers test asserting cacheSet with a value containing a sentinel like 'shpat_SENTINEL' never passes that sentinel to any logger method (mock ioredis client/getClient and @functions/helpers/logger).
Rules: TDD — failing test first, watch it fail. Comments say WHY only, never narrate WHAT; no step numbering, no banners. Backend logging via @functions/helpers/logger, never console.*. No secrets, no new dependencies, do not touch .env*, lockfiles, .gitlab-ci.yml, AGENTS.md. HARD RULE for packages/functions: never `await import(...)` a local module — .babelrc keeps import() native and prod throws ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND (jest hides it); lazy-load with require(). Run every verify command yourself; format with `DISABLE_V8_COMPILE_CACHE=1 npx eslint --fix <changed files>`. Final message: file:line per change and anything you could not do and why.
